Hanno Riverbed is experiencing high water levels due to Typhoon No. 6. The sandy islands were flooded following the typhoon's approach on June 2–3. On June 6 (Saturday) and June 7 (Sunday), if there is no rain, the fire-use area will operate normally. If it rains, staffed operations will not take place. BBQ and similar activities are permitted, but the current is fast and dangerous due to high water, so please do not enter the river for swimming or water play. Parents with children should take extra care. If you plan to visit, please check the official website "Hanno Riverbed. Ii-Shiome." in advance to confirm rules and guidelines.

For details, see Oku Musashi Hanno Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e6%b2%b3%e5%8e%9f6-6%e3%88%af%e3%83%bb7%e3%88%b0%e3%81%ae%e5%96%b6%e6%a5%ad%e3%81%ab%e3%81%a4%e3%81%84%e3%81%a6
summary: ℹ️ Hanno Riverbed: Operating status for June 6–7 (Saturday–Sunday)
